issue: जग in 'जग प्रयाग': the rest is settled by the same poet's signature in the Śītalā Chālīsā (chaupāīs 36–37: भनत रामसुन्दर प्रभुदासा । तट प्रयाग से पूरब पासा ॥ पुरी तिवारी मोर निवासा । ककरा गंगा तट दुर्वासा): one poet, Rāmasundara Prabhudāsa, living at Kakarā on the Gaṅgā, by Durvāsā's āśrama, east of Prayāga. Whether जग is 'world(-famed)' or a slip for तट (bank) is not settled.
our reading: Rāmasundara Prabhudāsa worships you; he lives near world-famed Prayāga, at Kakarā by Durvāsā's hermitage.
alternatives: जग a slip for तट: 'on the bank at Prayāga'.

issue: सम्वत् अपना सहस्र दश — the year of writing. 'सहस्र दश' reads as 'a thousand and ten' or 'ten thousand'; neither is a plausible Vikrama year, and the sources found do not explain it.
our reading: In my year one thousand and ten (सहस्र-दश), on Ṛṣi Pañcamī, a Sunday.
alternatives: A year written in a figure of speech; ten thousand; a corrupt numeral. Or a year coded in number-words (ऋषि = 7); but ऋषि पंचमी plainly reads as the calendar day.
